description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot configuration class 'OpenApiConfig' that sets up OpenAPI documentation (Swagger) and global CORS settings for a REST API. It dynamically adjusts server URLs based on environment variables to support different deployment environments and ensures Swagger UI can communicate with the API across different origins.

classes.name: OpenApiConfig
classes.description: Spring Boot configuration class for setting up OpenAPI (Swagger) documentation and global CORS policies.

methods.name: customOpenAPI
methods.description: Creates and configures the OpenAPI object with dynamic server URLs based on environment variables, supporting multiple deployment configurations, including preview, local development, and same-origin environments.

methods.name: corsConfigurer
methods.description: Configures global CORS settings to allow all origins, methods, and headers, facilitating Swagger UI integration and development/testing ease.
